Unique Home Staging Company travels throughout Eastern North Caroline working with homeowners, realtors, home flippers, builders and developers. With the help from our skilled team, your home will be looking more desirable and well above any comparables when it is put on the market.

The Purpose of Home Staging

Staging a home makes a great
impression that attracts Home Buyers.
To get a better asking price and to sell your home sooner, home staging is a MUST!
Experienced home stagers,like Unique Home Staging and Redesign, provide exceptional advice and service to recreate the interior of any home. They will present your home to its best advantage that will reflect a warm and inviting feeling.
The Result? More buyers become interested in your home in less time, and at a higher asking price.

Staging Vacant Homes

Homes that are vacant come across as cold and uninviting leaving buyers confused as to the proper function of the space. Unique Home Staging has a large inventory of furniture and décor available at reasonable rental rates for staging vacant home. We will transform any empty space into one desirable to all buyers.

Staging Process

At your convenience, Unique Home Staging and Redesign, will schedule an appointment to meet with you at the Home you would like to have staged. If you cannot make a appointment, you can give Unique home stager access to the home for viewing. The Stager will than contact you to discuss the rooms you would like to have staged, and also give you a evaluation as well. We can do as much or as little as you would like.
